final:
Both files are in `public/models/`, and both pass the no-visible-loss check (worst-region SSIM of 0.9 or higher). Each was compared against `assets/lantern.glb` at 1024px, with decoders and a cold load measured on a simulated 4g connection.

| | Original | `lantern-small.glb` | `lantern-gpu.glb` |
|---|---|---|---|
| File size | 9.56 MB | **0.91 MB** (‑90%) | 7.94 MB (‑17%) |
| GPU memory | 85.6 MiB | 85.5 MiB (about the same) | **21.5 MiB** (‑75%) |
| Cold load on 4g | 9.9–10.3 s | **2.1 s** | 10.8 s |
| Fidelity (SSIM) | n/a | 0.981 | 0.953 |
| Textures | 4× PNG 2048² | 4× AVIF 2048² | 4× KTX2 (UASTC) 2048² |
| Geometry | n/a | meshopt | meshopt |

- **Small:** AVIF shrinks the download by 10×, but the browser decodes it to raw pixels, so GPU memory stays at about 85 MiB. It is the better choice for first-load speed.
- **GPU:** KTX2 textures stay compressed in video memory, so GPU use drops by 4×. The download is still 7.9 MB, and it loads no faster than the original (10.8 s vs about 10 s). That includes a 267 KB transcoder and about 3.5 s of decode. It is the better choice if memory is the limit, for example on mobile or with many models on screen.
- **GPU retry:** My first GPU attempt used the default mixed ETC1S+UASTC mode. It was 5.2 MB but scored 0.886, below the 0.9 limit, so I redid it with UASTC only. That cost 2.7 MB of download size.
- **Babylon.js:**
  - Both files need the meshopt decoder.
  - The small file also needs AVIF support in the browser.
  - The GPU file also needs the KTX2 decoder. Babylon loads these decoders from its CDN by default, so self-host them if you can't use the CDN.
- **Smaller option:** The lantern's textures are 2048² with only 5,394 triangles. Capping textures at 1024 would cut both numbers a lot. I didn't do that because it's a visible-quality risk, but I can test it if you'd like.
bash_cmds:
node-assets optimize assets/lantern.glb -o public/models/lantern-small.glb --texture-format avif --geometry meshopt 2>&1 | tail -5
node-assets optimize assets/lantern.glb -o public/models/lantern-gpu.glb --texture-format ktx2 --geometry meshopt 2>&1 | tail -5
node-assets inspect public/models/lantern-small.glb public/models/lantern-gpu.glb --against assets/lantern.glb --view 1024 --network 4g
node-assets inspect public/models/lantern-small.glb public/models/lantern-gpu.glb --against assets/lantern.glb --view 1024 --network 4g 2>&1 | head -60
for f in small gpu; do node-assets inspect public/models/lantern-$f.glb --against assets/lantern.glb --view 1024 --network 4g 2>&1; done

node-assets optimize assets/lantern.glb -o public/models/lantern-gpu.glb --texture-format ktx2 --ktx2 uastc --geometry meshopt --force 2>&1 | tail -3; node-assets inspect public/models/lantern-gpu.glb --against assets/lantern.glb --view 1024 --network 4g 2>&1
until grep -q "original:" /tmp/claude-0/*/tasks/bvdkfhq73.output 2>/dev/null; do sleep 3; done; cat /tmp/claude-0/*/tasks/bvdkfhq73.output
